card.name: Map timeline
card.description: Radar, its forecast, clouds, lightning and other map layers live, or played on one timeline

config.invalid_sources: Invalid configuration. sources must be a list of the map layers to draw.
config.invalid_zone: Invalid zone. "{value}" isn't a zone such as zone.home.
config.invalid_zoom: Invalid zoom. {name} must be a number from 0 to {max}.
config.invalid_map_style: Invalid map style. map_style must be one of {values}.
config.invalid_map_height: Invalid height. map_height must be a number of pixels, at least 260.
config.invalid_speed: Invalid speed. speed must be the minutes played in a second, greater than 0.
config.invalid_type: Invalid source {n}. type must be one of {values}.
config.invalid_url: Invalid source {n}. url must be the address of its service, starting with https:// or http://.
config.invalid_xyz_url: Invalid source {n}. url must be a tile address with {z}, {x} and {y} in it, and the time as {time:YYYYMMDDHHmm} or in another pattern.
config.invalid_layer: Invalid source {n}. layer must be the name of a layer of its service.
config.invalid_rainviewer_layer: Invalid source {n}. layer must be one of {values}.
config.invalid_color_scheme: Invalid source {n}. color_scheme must be the number of one of its server's colour schemes.
config.invalid_max_zoom: Invalid source {n}. max_zoom must be a whole number from 0 to 22.
config.invalid_visible_minutes: Invalid source {n}. visible_minutes must be a number of minutes greater than 0.
config.invalid_timeline_marks: Invalid source {n}. timeline_marks must be true or false.
config.invalid_color: Invalid source {n}. color must be a hex colour such as #ffc107.
config.invalid_history_minutes: Invalid source {n}. history_minutes must be a number of minutes, 0 or more.
config.invalid_opacity: Invalid source {n}. opacity must be a number greater than 0 and at most 1.
config.invalid_legend: Invalid source {n}. legend must be false, or the address of a legend image.
config.invalid_stale_steps: Invalid source {n}. stale_steps must be a number, at least 1.
config.invalid_step_minutes: Invalid source {n}. step_minutes must be a number of minutes, at least 1.
config.invalid_delay_minutes: Invalid source {n}. delay_minutes must be a number of minutes, 0 or more.
config.invalid_row_step: Invalid rounding. row_step must be full or half.

bar.no_sources: No map layers yet. Add them under sources in the card's settings.

map_error.webgl: This browser can't draw the map, as it has no WebGL 2.
map_error.tiles: Home Assistant's map tiles aren't available. The card needs Home Assistant 2026.9 or newer.
map_error.style: The map couldn't be loaded. Check the errors in the browser's console.

gestures.windows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
gestures.mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
gestures.mobile: Use two fingers to move the map

editor.zone_helper: The map centres here. Home unless chosen.
editor.speed_helper: How many minutes of the feeds are played in a second.
editor.row_step_helper: With automatic row height, the card's height is rounded up to whole rows, or to half rows to save space.
editor.name: Name
editor.url_wms_helper: The WMS service's address, such as https://openwms.fmi.fi/geoserver/wms
editor.url_wmts_helper: The address of the server's capabilities document, such as its WMTSCapabilities.xml
editor.url_xyz_helper: The tile address, where the map fills in {z}, {x} and {y}. Mark the picture's time as, for example, {time:YYYYMMDDHHmm}. The time is in UTC.
editor.url_rainviewer_helper: The server's address, such as https://api.librewxr.net
editor.url_geojson_helper: The address of a GeoJSON feature collection
editor.layer_failed: The server's layers couldn't be read. Type the layer's name.
editor.layer_found: Layers tied to times on the server ({n})
editor.color_scheme_helper: The number of the colour scheme used. The first the server has, if none is chosen.
editor.history_minutes_helper: How far back the source goes.
editor.max_zoom_helper: How close a zoom the server offers pictures for. Closer than this, the card enlarges the closest pictures it has. Leave it empty if the map doesn't go blank when zoomed in. A WMTS server says its closest level itself.
editor.step_minutes_wms_helper: Used when the server doesn't set its step size itself.
editor.step_minutes_wmts_helper: Used when the server doesn't set its step size itself.
editor.step_minutes_xyz_helper: How often the server's picture is updated.
editor.step_minutes_geojson_helper: How often the data is updated. Also the timeline's step when no picture layer is on.
editor.step_minutes_geo_location_helper: The timeline's step when no picture layer is on.
editor.stale_steps: Warn when no new picture has come in this many steps
editor.delay_minutes_helper: How far behind now the newest picture is.
editor.visible_minutes_helper: How long a feature is shown on the map after its time stamp, slowly fading.
editor.color_helper: A hex colour such as #ffc107 for features without a colour of their own. The Home Assistant theme's primary colour unless chosen.
editor.attribution_helper: Shown behind the map's info button. The source's own unless given.
editor.time_property_helper: The field that holds a feature's time stamp. Without it, every feature of the feed is always shown.
editor.source_helper: Shows only the geo_location entities whose source attribute has this value, such as blitzortung. Left empty, every geo_location entity is shown.
